subject: a young South Indian Tamil man of the early 1900s with a round face, thick wavy dark hair, a large forehead and bright sharp dark eyes, wearing a white cotton dhoti and a plain long buttoned coat, a vertical Vaishnava mark on his forehead, quiet and intent

panels.01-erode: a modest tiled-roof house on a narrow street in a small South Indian town on the Kaveri river in 1887, coconut palms, a temple tower in the distance, women in cotton saris drawing water, early morning, wide establishing shot, calm
panels.02-carr: a teenage version of {S} at about fifteen sitting cross-legged on the stone verandah of a house in the temple town of Kumbakonam in 1903, reading a thick old mathematics book and writing formulas with a pen in a notebook, an oil lamp beside him, a temple gopuram tower in the background, deep concentration
panels.03-porttrust: {S} at a wooden clerk's desk in a colonial harbour office in Madras in 1912, account ledgers stacked beside him, quietly filling a separate sheet of paper with mathematical symbols, ceiling fan, tall shuttered windows looking out on sailing ships and cranes, other clerks working
panels.04-letter: {S} seated at a small wooden table in a simple Madras room at night in 1913, carefully folding many handwritten pages of mathematics into an envelope addressed to England, an oil lamp casting warm light, a stack of worn notebooks beside him, hope and resolve
panels.05-voyage: {S} in a dark Western suit standing at the rail of a steamship leaving Madras harbour in 1914, holding a cloth-bound notebook, the city shoreline and lighthouse behind, seabirds, a mix of courage and homesickness
panels.06-trinity: {S} in a dark Western suit and an older thin English mathematician with short hair and a tweed jacket standing together at a blackboard covered in chalk formulas in a wood-panelled room at Trinity College Cambridge in 1916, Gothic window, books piled on a table, lively discussion
panels.07-lastwork: a thin and tired but alert {S} seated on a bed with a writing board on his lap in a quiet South Indian house in 1920, writing formulas on loose sheets of paper, a window with palm trees outside, soft light, calm dignity, not sad
panels.08-lostnotebook: an American mathematician in the 1970s in a jacket opening an old cardboard box of yellowed loose handwritten pages in the oak-panelled Wren Library at Trinity College Cambridge, tall bookcases and marble busts, a shaft of afternoon light, wonder and discovery
